title: Collaborative Research: Theory and Implementation of Semidefinite Programming and Its Application to Combinatorial Optimization
contribution: NSF award abstract placing SDP algorithms in two classes (second-order IP vs first-order NLP) chosen mainly by problem size; research plan not in the stored abstract.
problem_entry: SDP introduced as a broad modelling class with applications in combinatorial optimization, engineering, statistics and robust optimization (abstract).
key_idea: IP methods for small/medium SDPs, first-order NLP methods for large-scale ones; problem size decides (abstract).
positioning: Background for the first-order/low-rank NLP line (abstract).
limits_future: n/a (proposal); planned work not in stored abstract
coauthors: SA Burer (collaborative award; partner not named in metadata)

quotes.text: The choice of which class to use for a particular application is determined primarily by problem size --- second-order IP methods are more efficient on small- to medium-scale problems while first-order NLP methods are better for large-scale problems.

title: Correction to: Exact semidefinite formulations for a class of (random and non-random) nonconvex quadratic programs
contribution: Published correction (Math. Program. 190:845-848) to the 2020 Burer-Ye article on exact Shor relaxations for diagonal, general and random QCQPs; the stored abstract is the original article's, and the correction text was not read here.
problem_entry: When is the basic Shor SDP relaxation exact for QCQPs? Entry via diagonal QCQPs with no off-diagonal terms (abstract of original article).
key_idea: Polynomial-time-checkable sufficient condition for Shor exactness in diagonal QCQPs, carried to general QCQPs by reformulating to diagonal form, then extended to random QCQPs with high probability (abstract of original article).
assumptions: Number of constraints grows no faster than a fixed polynomial in n for the random result (abstract).
positioning: Condition said to complement and refine existing exactness conditions (abstract).
limits_future: The correction amends the 2020 article (Crossref update-to 10.1007/s10107-019-01367-2); its contents were not read in this batch.

method_links.note: Exact SDP formulation of a nonconvex class with a checkable exactness condition
Published correction linked to the original article by Crossref; text not read here

quotes.text: By reformulating a general QCQP into diagonal form, we establish new, polynomial-time-checkable sufficient conditions for the semidefinite relaxations of general QCQPs to be exact.
To the best of our knowledge, this is the first result establishing the exactness of the semidefinite relaxation for random general QCQPs.
